title: Saving a customer with a rep turned off in another tab is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Starting screen: {Customer-A}'s page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide, and Settings > Staff is open in a second tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the first tab, open Edit Customer and click the Sales Representative field so {Sales-rep-B} is listed.
  2. In the second tab, turn {Sales-rep-B}'s "Sales Representative" switch off and save.
  3. In the first tab, pick {Sales-rep-B} and save the customer.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the dropdown lists {Sales-rep-B}.
  • Step 2: the staff record saves.
  • Step 3: the save is refused with "The selected staff member is not a sales representative." and {Customer-A} keeps no representative.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S1-N2: “A staff member whose Sales Representative switch is off is not listed and cannot be picked. If one is sent by any other route, the system refuses it with "The selected staff member is not a sales representative."”

From: Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, uploaded 19 Oct 2026), read 19 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, customer validation (D5): “A `user_id` the customer does not already hold on any side must also be an active user with a staff row flagged `is_sales_rep`. Both failures return 400 "The selected staff member is not a sales representative."”
